name: megascenes-new-year-card
description: Design New Year cards with your own wish and names in the design, for 2027 and beyond, in the style you choose.

interface.shortDescription: New Year cards with your words
interface.longDescription:
Give the wish, who the card is from and the look you want: gold fireworks, a midnight countdown, champagne and confetti, a calm winter sunrise. You get a New Year card with your words set in the design, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For friends, family, clients and team greetings.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set your wish and names in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Happy New Year 2027 card with gold fireworks from the Rossi family
A New Year card for my clients: thank you and best wishes for 2027
A calm New Year card with a winter sunrise and the words New beginnings

positive.prompt: A Happy New Year 2027 card with gold fireworks from the Rossi family. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one New Year card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A New Year card for my clients that says thank you and best wishes for 2027. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a New Year card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The New Year card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A calm New Year card with a winter sunrise and the words New beginnings. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my New Year card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my New Year card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
